SELECT o.customer_name as customerName, SUM(COALESCE(dlv.delivered_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rcv.received_amount, 0)) as totalOutstanding, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) >= 0 AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) <= 30, COALESCE(dlv.delivered_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rcv.received_amount, 0), 0)) as agingCurrent, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) > 30 AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) <= 90, COALESCE(dlv.delivered_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rcv.received_amount, 0), 0)) as aging1to3, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) > 90 AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) <= 180, COALESCE(dlv.delivered_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rcv.received_amount, 0), 0)) as aging3to6, SUM(IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.receivable_date) > 180, COALESCE(dlv.delivered_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rcv.received_amount, 0), 0)) as aging6plus FROM mis_sales_order o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source_order_id, SUM(delivery_amount) as delivered_amount FROM mis_delivery WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY source_order_id ) dlv ON o.id = dlv.source_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rd.sales_order_id, SUM(rd.receipt_amount) as received_amount FROM mis_receipt_order_detail rd JOIN mis_receipt_order r ON rd.receipt_id = r.id WHERE rd.del_flag = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '1' GROUP BY rd.sales_order_id ) rcv ON o.id = rcv.sales_order_id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.receivable_date IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(dlv.delivered_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rcv.received_amount, 0)) > 0
AND o.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.customerName}, '%')
GROUP BY o.customer_name ORDER BY totalOutstanding DESC
